tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently attended a cooking class and thoroughly enjoyed the experience. You found the instructor, Ms. Baker, very helpful and want to thank her for the enjoyable class. Write an email to Ms. Baker.
bullets: Mention why you enjoyed the class.
Request advice and resources to improve your cooking skills.
tasks.subject: Request for additional cooking tips
